title: Zero-C2 Stigmergic OSINT Bounty Settlement Schema (v1.0)
description: Deterministic state-transition contract for trustless zk-SNARK and adaptor-signature proof-of-verification bounty markets. Enforces Tokens_Chat = 0, zero platform rent, and statutory public-interest predicate gating.

bounty_beacon_layer1.description: Layer 1 pheromone deposit: objective machine-verifiable predicate P(D) = 1 escrow beacon.

bounty_usd.description: Locked bounty B in USD. Must satisfy B + C_Gas/ZK < Delta_V_Clearance (Theorem 1) and B - C_Solve > V_Hoard_Effective (Theorem 2).

verification_key_hash.description: SHA-256 digest of the Groth16 verification key vk_P bound to predicate P.

tokens_chat.description: Zero-C2 invariant: no interactive coordination channel exists.

statutory_public_interest_ast_compliant.description: Predicate P must belong to AST_StatutoryPublicInterest; otherwise VerifierContract(vk_P) = REJECT.

zk_adaptor_settlement_layer2.description: Layer 2 zero-knowledge witness plus BIP-340 functional adaptor signature atomic settlement.

prover_cycles.description: zkVM cycle count. Route A RSA-2048 baseline is 17,400,000 cycles.

live_oracle_bandwidth_mb.description: Live network traffic in MB. Route A is 0.0 MB (fully offline); Route B TLSNotary is 25 + 10*TX_KB + 0.04*RX_KB.

ciphertext_cid_sha256.description: Content-addressed digest H_C of ciphertext C_D = Enc_{K_D}(D).

adaptor_key_extracted.description: K_D = sigma - tilde_sigma (mod q) is publicly extractable in the same block as payout.

platform_rent_pct.description: Zero platform rent invariant: no brokerage or intermediary cut.

game_theoretic_equilibria.description: Closed-form equilibrium bounds for the four governing theorems.

funder_human_review_hours.description: Reverse-Turing RLVR gate imposes zero human review load.
